title: Knowledge Website Indexing API Contract
description: Submit a website URL for sitemap-based crawling, text extraction, chunking, and embedding

url.description: Website base URL (http/https). Sitemap.xml will be auto-discovered.

title.description: Optional display title. Defaults to hostname.

response_400.description: Invalid request body or URL format / SSRF blocked

steps: 1. Fetch sitemap.xml (or sitemap_index.xml) from base URL
2. Parse URLs, filter by robots.txt Disallow rules
4. For each URL: fetch HTML, extract text via HtmlAgilityPack
6. Chunk text (512 words, 50 word overlap — same as PDF)
7. Store chunks with metadata: {url, page_title, token_count}

notes: document.source_type = 'website', file_path stores the base URL
Re-crawl: DELETE document (CASCADE chunks) then re-submit URL
Search integration: zero changes — RetrievalService searches all chunks regardless of source_type
Chunk metadata_json: {url, page_title, token_count} instead of {page_number, token_count}
